execute.sql: CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS "public"

CREATE TABLE "public"."courses" (
  "course_id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "created_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "description" text,
  "instructor_id" int4 NOT NULL,
  "review_feedback" text,
  "reviewed_at" timestamptz,
  "reviewed_by_id" int4,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'draft' NOT NULL,
  "submitted_at" timestamptz,
  "target_level" text NOT NULL,
  "title" character varying(255) NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("course_id"),
  CONSTRAINT "courses_rejection_has_feedback_2718b32d" CHECK (status <> 'rejected' OR review_feedback IS NOT NULL),
  CONSTRAINT "courses_status_check_f2707368" CHECK ("status" IN ('draft', 'pending_review', 'approved', 'rejected', 'archived')),
  CONSTRAINT "courses_target_level_check_0bfcbf74" CHECK ("target_level" IN ('beginner', 'intermediate', 'advanced'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."enrollments" (
  "completed_at" timestamptz,
  "course_id" int4 NOT NULL,
  "enrolled_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "user_id" int4 NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("user_id", "course_id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."lesson_progress" (
  "completed_at" timestamptz,
  "lesson_id" int4 NOT NULL,
  "started_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'in_progress' NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "user_id" int4 NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("user_id", "lesson_id"),
  CONSTRAINT "lesson_progress_completed_at_f8d33380" CHECK ((status = 'completed') = (completed_at IS NOT NULL)),
  CONSTRAINT "lesson_progress_status_check_d625c9f0" CHECK ("status" IN ('in_progress', 'completed'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."lesson_skills" (
  "lesson_id" int4 NOT NULL,
  "skill_id" int4 NOT NULL,
  "weight" float8 DEFAULT 1 NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("lesson_id", "skill_id"),
  CONSTRAINT "lesson_skills_weight_range_3ac91c16" CHECK (weight > 0 AND weight <= 1)
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."lessons" (
  "content" text,
  "course_id" int4 NOT NULL,
  "created_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "kind" text DEFAULT 'core' NOT NULL,
  "lesson_id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "order_index" int4 NOT NULL,
  "title" character varying(255) NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("lesson_id"),
  CONSTRAINT "lessons_kind_check_d093d521" CHECK ("kind" IN ('core', 'remedial')),
  CONSTRAINT "lessons_order_index_nonnegative_a6202c44" CHECK (order_index >= 0)
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."passages_media" (
  "content" text,
  "created_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "created_by_id" int4 NOT NULL,
  "lesson_id" int4,
  "media_path" character varying(1024),
  "order_index" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "passage_id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "title" character varying(255),
  "type" text NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("passage_id"),
  CONSTRAINT "passages_media_has_payload_6cee5a49" CHECK ((type = 'reading_text' AND content IS NOT NULL) OR (type <> 'reading_text' AND media_path IS NOT NULL)),
  CONSTRAINT "passages_media_type_check_7edc1389" CHECK ("type" IN ('reading_text', 'listening_audio', 'video'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."question_responses" (
  "answered_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "attempt_id" int4 NOT NULL,
  "attempt_order" int4 NOT NULL,
  "is_correct" bool NOT NULL,
  "question_id" int4 NOT NULL,
  "response_id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "response_time_seconds" float8,
  "user_answer" jsonb NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("response_id"),
  CONSTRAINT "question_responses_order_positive_0c60fab0" CHECK (attempt_order >= 1),
  CONSTRAINT "question_responses_time_nonnegative_fbecd90a" CHECK (response_time_seconds IS NULL OR response_time_seconds >= 0)
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."question_skills" (
  "question_id" int4 NOT NULL,
  "skill_id" int4 NOT NULL,
  "weight" float8 NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("question_id", "skill_id"),
  CONSTRAINT "question_skills_weight_range_3ac91c16" CHECK (weight > 0 AND weight <= 1)
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."questions" (
  "answer_key" jsonb NOT NULL,
  "created_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "created_by_id" int4 NOT NULL,
  "difficulty" int2 DEFAULT 3 NOT NULL,
  "explanation" text,
  "options" jsonb,
  "passage_id" int4,
  "question_id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "question_text" text NOT NULL,
  "question_type" text NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("question_id"),
  CONSTRAINT "questions_difficulty_range_6ed448a4" CHECK (difficulty BETWEEN 1 AND 5),
  CONSTRAINT "questions_question_type_check_9265baa9" CHECK ("question_type" IN ('multiple_choice', 'true_false_not_given', 'gap_fill', 'matching', 'error_identification'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."quiz_attempts" (
  "attempt_id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "completed_at" timestamptz,
  "mastery_changes" jsonb,
  "max_score" int4 NOT NULL,
  "quiz_id" int4 NOT NULL,
  "started_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "total_score" int4,
  "user_id" int4 NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("attempt_id"),
  CONSTRAINT "quiz_attempts_score_on_complete_422c0529" CHECK ((completed_at IS NULL) = (total_score IS NULL)),
  CONSTRAINT "quiz_attempts_score_range_d229c75f" CHECK (total_score IS NULL OR total_score BETWEEN 0 AND max_score),
  CONSTRAINT "quiz_attempts_time_order_307f78e9" CHECK (completed_at IS NULL OR completed_at >= started_at)
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."quiz_questions" (
  "order_index" int4 NOT NULL,
  "question_id" int4 NOT NULL,
  "quiz_id" int4 NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("quiz_id", "question_id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."quizzes" (
  "created_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "created_by_id" int4 NOT NULL,
  "description" text,
  "kind" text NOT NULL,
  "lesson_id" int4,
  "quiz_id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "time_limit_seconds" int4,
  "title" character varying(255) NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("quiz_id"),
  CONSTRAINT "quizzes_kind_check_007bfe91" CHECK ("kind" IN ('diagnostic', 'lesson', 'practice')),
  CONSTRAINT "quizzes_kind_lesson_link_94be95bb" CHECK ((kind <> 'lesson' OR lesson_id IS NOT NULL) AND (kind <> 'diagnostic' OR lesson_id IS NULL)),
  CONSTRAINT "quizzes_time_limit_positive_f7eae20a" CHECK (time_limit_seconds IS NULL OR time_limit_seconds > 0)
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."recommendations" (
  "clicked_at" timestamptz,
  "created_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "lesson_id" int4,
  "mastery_prob" float8 NOT NULL,
  "quiz_id" int4,
  "rank" int2 NOT NULL,
  "rationale" text NOT NULL,
  "recommendation_id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "score" float8 NOT NULL,
  "skill_id" int4 NOT NULL,
  "source_attempt_id" int4,
  "user_id" int4 NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("recommendation_id"),
  CONSTRAINT "recommendations_mastery_range_03ef29df" CHECK (mastery_prob BETWEEN 0 AND 1),
  CONSTRAINT "recommendations_one_target_95601bd0" CHECK (num_nonnulls(lesson_id, quiz_id) = 1),
  CONSTRAINT "recommendations_rank_positive_44134b3b" CHECK (rank >= 1)
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."skills" (
  "category" text NOT NULL,
  "created_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "description" text,
  "name" character varying(255) NOT NULL,
  "skill_code" character varying(64) NOT NULL,
  "skill_id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("skill_id"),
  CONSTRAINT "skills_category_check_4a3c23aa" CHECK ("category" IN ('listening', 'reading', 'writing', 'speaking')),
  CONSTRAINT "skills_code_format_41111c46" CHECK (skill_code ~ '^[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]*$')
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."user_skill_mastery" (
  "mastery_prob" float8 NOT NULL,
  "observations" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "skill_id" int4 NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "user_id" int4 NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("user_id", "skill_id"),
  CONSTRAINT "user_skill_mastery_prob_range_03ef29df" CHECK (mastery_prob BETWEEN 0 AND 1)
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."users" (
  "created_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "email" character varying(255) NOT NULL,
  "full_name" character varying(255) NOT NULL,
  "hashed_pass" character varying(255) NOT NULL,
  "is_active" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "role" text DEFAULT 'learner' NOT NULL,
  "target_band" float8,
  "updated_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "user_id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("user_id"),
  CONSTRAINT "users_role_check_f28eb4e5" CHECK ("role" IN ('learner', 'instructor', 'admin')),
  CONSTRAINT "users_target_band_half_steps_cbff5ae5" CHECK (target_band IS NULL OR (target_band BETWEEN 0 AND 9 AND target_band * 2 = trunc(target_band * 2)))
)
